content:
Cryptocurrency investments have recently grown more popular. Today, there is a larger group of people investing in cryptocurrencies. However, despite its popularity, the area is not yet fully understood by many.  

Ever wondered why this happens?  

It is usually because crypto tax calculation is a difficult process to begin with. It requires dealing with a lot of things, like digital crypto wallets, cryptocurrencies, and crypto exchanges. Furthermore, you’ll have to calculate the net profit and loss and then, eventually file and submit the tax returns to the IRS (Internal Revenue Service). 

Therefore, to make the process less complicated, people use crypto tax calculators. Crypto tax calculators can help you understand crypto taxes better by optimizing and automating your bookkeeping processes and ensuring that you comply with the tax regulations of your state or country. Now, let’s have a look at the five best ones that topped the charts in 2024. 

1. Accointing 

This crypto tax calculator offers services for both crypto tracking and tax reporting. It has tools that enable users to generate tax reports, calculate tax loss, analyze portfolios, track the cryptocurrency market, etc. 

Key Features: 

  • Offers free trial for up to 25 transactions 
  • Supports tax loss harvesting 
  • Enables manual tracking for NFT transactions 

2. CoinTracking 

CoinTracking is an excellent option for diversified traders and investors. It enables users to track activities across varied crypto exchanges. Apart from that, it also provides them with every detail about the cryptocurrency market trends using automation features. 

Key Features: 

  • Available on a free trial 
  • Supports cost basis and cash flow analysis 
  • Works with multiple crypto wallets 

3. BitcoinTaxes 

With this crypto tax calculator, you can carry out faster crypto calculations, exchange imports, and easily file or download taxes. Here, the taxpayer only needs to add or upload transactions from different digital wallets or crypto exchanges they have used. The rest, which is calculating capital gains, will be done by the software. 

Key Features: 

  • Enables tax-loss harvesting 
  • Calculates gains or losses on capitals 
  • Offers tax preparation services 

4. Koinly 

The best part of using this crypto tax calculator is that it lets you easily connect with varied digital wallets, blockchain addresses, investing apps, and crypto exchanges. It will also give you a clear idea of your crypto activities across various platforms. This software works best for individuals and businesses that need to file and calculate both international and local taxes. 

Key Features: 

  • Available on a free trial 
  • Supports cost basis and cash flow analysis 
  • Works with multiple crypto wallets 

5. TaxBit 

This is another great crypto tax calculator that simplifies the tax filing process. It lets you track your crypto activities and converts data into crypto tax reports. The synchronization and conversion of data usually happen with the help of automation technology that comes in-built into the software. 

Key Features: 

  • Has an easy-to-use dashboard 
  • Supports integration of PayPal and CoinBase 
  • Offers audit assistance and cost basis

title: 3 Easy Ways to Simplify Technology Investments
excerpt: Companies today are facing a lot of challenges with respect to investment. The proliferation of technology and the growth of the enterprise software market has made it challenging for them to determine which tools and solutions to invest in.   Furthermore, there are over 30,000 SaaS offerings available. This makes it difficult for businesses to navigate the […]
content:
Companies today are facing a lot of challenges with respect to investment. The proliferation of technology and the growth of the enterprise software market has made it challenging for them to determine which tools and solutions to invest in.  

Furthermore, there are over 30,000 SaaS offerings available. This makes it difficult for businesses to navigate the landscape and choose the right products for their needs. Nevertheless, the enterprise software market is expected to continue its growth—reaching $404 billion by 2028 with an 11.1% CAGR. 

With so many options available, it’s important to make informed decisions about which technology solutions to invest in to ensure they deliver a good return on investment. Go through the following evaluation framework to simplify technology investments and ensure your technology stack is supporting your most critical business initiatives.  

1. Carry Out an Audit of the Must-Have Use Cases 

It’s important for companies to have a clear understanding of what they are trying to achieve with technology investments. Identifying the areas of the business that need attention, and the specific use cases for the technology can help ensure that technology purchases align with the organization’s goals and provide the greatest value.  

Some common objectives for technology investments include generating leads, improving lead management, updating engineering tools, and implementing a sales enablement system. By prioritizing their technology needs, organizations can make informed decisions about which solutions to invest in and how to allocate their IT budget. 

2. Choose Vendors and Tools and Vendors That Solves Multiple Use Cases 

When considering technology investments, it’s important to strike a balance between finding the best-of-breed solution for each specific use case and consolidating tools to maximize ROI. Many software vendors are offering multi-functional tools that can be used for a variety of business needs.  

For instance, Salesforce is a leading CRM tool that can also be used for email marketing and social media management. In some cases, it may make sense to choose a tool that is not the best in its category but can still meet the needs of the organization and offer cost savings through consolidation.  

To make the right decision, it’s important to carefully evaluate the trade-offs between best-of-breed solutions and consolidation, and choose the option that provides the best value for the organization. 

3. Negotiate Good Price With Bundles 

Implementing dedicated tools for every use case may not always be the most efficient approach. Having a large number of tools in your technology stack can be time-consuming and expensive to manage. Also, it increases the risk of security breaches.  

To minimize these risks and reduce costs, it can be beneficial to consolidate your technology stack by choosing bundled solutions that meet multiple critical use case requirements. By consolidating your tools and technologies, you can lower capital expenses and reduce ongoing administrative overhead, while still ensuring that you have the necessary tools to meet all your critical use cases. This approach can help streamline your technology stack and reduce the risk of cybercrime. 

Final Note 

The outlook for 2024 is uncertain, and it’s wise to be frugal. Reviewing tech stacks and consolidating tools to reduce waste and increase ROI is a smart approach for organizations to maintain efficiency and ensure success.

title: 3D-IC: Conducting Advantages and Promising Future
excerpt: 3D ICs are a revolutionary new approach to chip design that stacks multiple layers of transistors vertically, instead of just laying them out flat on a single plane. This allows for significant improvements in performance, integration, miniaturization, and energy efficiency.
content:
The semiconductor industry is the backbone of modern electronics, powering everything from smartphones and laptops to cars and airplanes. As technology continues to evolve, the demand for ever-more powerful and efficient chips is constantly growing. However, traditional scaling approaches, which have miniaturized transistors over the past few decades, are reaching their physical limits.

This is where 3D IC technology comes in. 3D ICs are a revolutionary new approach to chip design that stacks multiple layers of transistors vertically, instead of just laying them out flat on a single plane. This allows for significant improvements in performance, integration, miniaturization, and energy efficiency.

Advantages of 3D IC Technology

Following are some of the advantages of 3D IC technology.

Improved Performance

By stacking multiple layers of transistors, 3D ICs can achieve significantly shorter signal paths, leading to faster processing speeds. This is critical for applications such as artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, and autonomous vehicles.

Increased Integration

3D ICs allow for the integration of more transistors on a single chip. This enables the creation of more complex and powerful devices, such as system-on-a-chip (SoC) designs that combine multiple processing cores, memory, and other functionalities.

Miniaturization

3D ICs can help to shrink the size of electronic devices. This is important for a variety of applications, from mobile phones and tablets to wearable electronics.

Energy Efficiency

Shorter signal paths and improved thermal management in 3D ICs can lead to lower power consumption. This is beneficial for battery-powered devices and for reducing the environmental impact of electronics.

The Future of 3D IC Technology

3D IC technology is still in its early stages of development, but it has the potential to revolutionize the semiconductor industry. As research and development efforts continue, we can expect to see even more improvements in performance, integration, miniaturization, and energy efficiency.

Here are some of the key trends to watch in the future of 3D IC technology.

Development of new materials and processes

New materials and processes are needed to enable the creation of even more complex and efficient 3D ICs.

Integration of 3D ICs with other technologies

3D ICs can be integrated with other emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence and neuromorphic computing, to create even more powerful and intelligent devices.

The adoption of 3D IC technology has the potential to drive innovation, competition, and growth in the semiconductor industry. This technology is essential for meeting the growing demand for high-performance and efficient chips. By investing in 3D IC research and development, India can position itself as a leader in this critical technology.

title: 4 Brands That Nailed UX and What You Can Learn from Them
excerpt: The foundation of a brand’s online presence is UX.
content:
The foundation of a brand’s online presence is UX. Creating user-friendly, pleasurable, and smooth interactions is more important than merely having things appear nice. Here are the four companies that have established the benchmark for UX design through their technological know-how, inventiveness, and customer-focused approach. Let’s examine how they accomplished it and what you might learn for your own endeavours.

1.Apple: Elegant and Simple

Apple has always taken a minimalist approach to UX. Apple’s design philosophy places a high priority on user convenience, as shown in the clear, simple interface of iOS and the smooth integration throughout its ecosystem.

What they did correctly:
• Maintained consistency across platforms and devices
• Made setup procedures and navigation simple, especially for inexperienced users
• Put an emphasis on minimalism without sacrificing functionality

The lesson is to keep things simple. Determine the essential features that your users require and remove any extraneous complexity. Platform consistency fosters familiarity and confidence.

2.Spotify: Personalized Experiences

Spotify’s highly customized experiences transformed the way we listen to music. Spotify’s UX makes sure consumers feel as though the platform knows their preferences, from Discover Weekly to carefully crafted playlists.

What they did correctly:
• Utilized AI and data to provide customized suggestions
• Developed an intuitive user experience that prioritizes exploration and discovery
• Smooth integration of features like offline playback

The takeaway is to use data to customize user experiences. Recognize the tastes of your audience and create solutions that seem tailored to them.

3.Airbnb: Giving Users Power

Both hosts and guests are empowered by Airbnb’s UX. Listing houses, scheduling stays, and discovering unusual experiences are all made simple by their platform. By emphasizing openness and confidence, they have established a worldwide community.

What they did correctly:
• Added elements like host ratings and guest reviews to build confidence
• Designed a smooth booking experience with transparent pricing and thorough property details
• Put a lot of effort into making the platform user-friendly for a range of audiences

Lesson learned: Give users clear information and easy-to-use tools to empower them. Transparency is crucial for establishing trust, particularly in peer-to-peer marketplaces.

4.Duolingo: Effective Gamification

Although learning a new language can be intimidating, Duolingo’s user interface makes it enjoyable and captivating. The app keeps users interested and motivated by gamifying learning into a game.

What they did correctly:
• Added features like leaderboards, awards, and streaks to promote consistent use
• Created lessons in manageable chunks to accommodate users’ hectic schedules
• Offered real-time feedback and progress monitoring

Gamification has the potential to improve engagement. Look for ways to add features that will motivate and reward users to your product.

Concluding

These companies created their designs with people in mind, not just looks. They produced memorable experiences by knowing their audiences, streamlining procedures, and putting user needs first. These UX success stories offer valuable insights for anyone developing a digital product, be it an app, website, or something else entirely.

title: 5 Best Tax Software in 2024
excerpt: Do you file the taxes yourself or rely on professionals to do the same? Having a professional complete your taxes can cost you somewhere between $176 – $273. This cost shall vary depending on whether you properly itemize your deductions or not.   On the other hand, doing taxes yourself will cost you less. Sometimes, […]
content:
Do you file the taxes yourself or rely on professionals to do the same? Having a professional complete your taxes can cost you somewhere between $176 – $273. This cost shall vary depending on whether you properly itemize your deductions or not.  

On the other hand, doing taxes yourself will cost you less. Sometimes, it may not even cost you anything. The only thing you need is tax software and you can easily file and complete your taxes online. Moreover, you can also use the tax software for simple as well as complex tax returns. 

Now, let’s have a look at some of the best tax software available today that can help you do your taxes yourself. 

1. TurboTax 

TurboTax ranks first in our listings due to its easy-to-use interface. The software has a question-answer format to help users easily complete taxes. It usually comes in four versions, starting from free to self-employed users. TurboTax also helps those who aren’t comfortable completing taxes themselves and need professional help by offering them the option of tax experts’ assistance.  

2. Jackson Hewitt 

Jackson Hewitt mainly offers tax services in person. It has around 6,000 offices, out of which 3,000 are based inside Walmart stores. Its software comes with a step-by-step format and guarantees maximum refund, satisfaction, and accuracy. The software also provides online help from tax professionals when filing with the use of a drop-off tax service. 

3. TaxSlayer 

The pricing of TaxSlayer starts at zero and goes to $52.95. There will be additional charges to file a state return, especially for the top three-tiered products. When it comes to the cost for state returns, there will be none in the free version.  

4. Cash App Taxes 

Cash App Taxes, formerly known as Credit Karma is the most affordable tax software on the list. This software allows you to file one-state or federal tax returns for free. Apart from that, the software also enables you to get maximum and faster refunds, which is two days faster than the usual ones. 

5. H&R Block 

If you’re looking for tax software that has the best filing options, then H&R Block will be winning the bet. It provides tax filling options in both online and downloadable formats, be it through in-person or a mobile app. The options in this software come in the question-answer form and can be relied upon to handle even the most complex tax situations.

title: 5 Common Vulnerability Remediation Mistakes Organization Should Avoid
excerpt: Vulnerability management is often under-sourced and under-tooled and yet stands at the epicenter of protecting the organization from a breach.
content:
Effective vulnerability remediation is essential to security. The trouble is, it’s tough!

Vulnerability management is often under-sourced and under-tooled and yet stands at the epicenter of protecting an organization from a breach.

Cybersecurity stakes continue to rise. The average cost of a data breach in the United States in 2020 rose to $8.64 million, up 5% over 2019. And regulators are imposing increasingly stiff fines for lapses in personal data security. The vast majority of exploits take advantage of old, known vulnerabilities.

So, it’s no wonder why security leaders are striving to make their vulnerability remediation programs more effective and dramatically improve cyber hygiene. In this blog, we identify the five most common mistakes keeping IT security teams from effective vulnerability remediation.

Avoid these mistakes, protect your company, and avoid the dreaded headlines.
Let’s get started!

Focusing only on the latest headlines

Many organizations set out with the best of intentions but get waylaid by the ‘latest and greatest’ vulnerabilities.

Heartbleed. Poodle. Shellshock.

These ‘headliners’ might seem like your biggest concern. But ultimately, you’re far more likely to be breached as a result of unpatched software or an outdated operating system.

To put this in perspective, think about human illnesses. Swine flu and Ebola might seem like a huge issue, but you’re still far more likely to come down with a common cold.

Ultimately, you’ll leave your organization severely vulnerable to much more commonly abused threats by over-focusing on these headline vulnerabilities and committing too many resources to resolve them.

Inefficient risk prioritization

The sheer number of vulnerabilities that need to be addressed in a typical enterprise can overwhelm even the most experienced IT shops.

Even if an organization is committed to proactive bug management, it can still fail to address the worst vulnerabilities before they are exploited. This can happen if you don’t properly prioritize remediation based on risk.

This means a formalized ranking system based on variables like the following.

  • Severity of vulnerability
  • Software’s importance
  • Sensitivity of the data it holds
  • Sensitivity of systems running the software

Kenna Security’s research finding reveals that digital attackers tend to craft exploit code for an extremely small percentage of known security holes. It, therefore, doesn’t make sense for organizations to treat all vulnerabilities the same. Nor is it beneficial for organizations to drop everything that they’re doing and direct all their focus to a flaw that the media has hyped up for no meaningful reason. Instead, organizations should look to prioritize their vulnerability management efforts.

Poorly placed scanners

Many times people in trenches who are performing vulnerability assessments don’t have a big-picture view of network topology. They might not be aware of where internal firewalls, IDS/IPS sensors, and WAN connections sit. This can cause big problems.

These teams try to perform scans from a central location and get erroneous results because other security tools and network bandwidth block an assessment. NAT environments and connection limitations can also wreak havoc on a scan even if they get whitelisting rules in place. Properly architecting vulnerability remediation is key to providing meaningful and accurate results.

Not automating remediation

Let’s just come out and say it: Manual patching doesn’t work. Given the sheer volume of vulnerabilities, the limited resources of security and IT teams, and the often complex procedures to navigate, manual patching can only ever be a slow, infrequent, and frustrating process.

If you’re stuck manually patching your applications and systems, It is practically guaranteed that they’re not fully up-to-date and secure. You can ensure patching happens promptly without requiring massive resources by looking instead to automate the remediation process from start to finish.

Lack of collaboration

This shouldn’t come as a surprise, but no one can handle remediation all by themselves. First of all, the task is too massive. In 2019 alone, 17,000 vulnerabilities were added to the U.S. National Vulnerability Database.

Second, even if you trim that list to the highest-risk vulnerabilities, you still have to work with other members of your company to arrange the best time for the remediation to take place.

Third, security teams need IT and operations to get remediation done, but the groups are often working in silos. While security teams are raising red flags about vulnerabilities and attempting to remediate them, IT and operations teams are often more concerned with business continuity. Without a handshake between them, vulnerabilities don’t get remediated.

It’s all in the plan

Software vulnerabilities are an unavoidable fact of life for enterprise IT Teams. New ones are found all the time and older ones are still being exploited. It’s a “drinking-from-the-firehose” situation that can no longer be ignored.

In the end, avoiding these vulnerability remediation mistakes comes down to planning.
If your process is well-planned, well-resourced, and well-documented, you’ll find problems are kept to a minimum. Sure, things will go wrong now and again, but you’ll be in a very strong position to deal with them.

In the long run, it’s much easier to fix your process now than it will be to continually fight the fires caused by a lack of planning, resources, or documentation.

title: 5 Must-Know Software Development Aspects for Every Fintech Startup
excerpt: Just like any other business, software development is critical to Fintech. Even a minor error can lead to long-term consequences. So, it is necessary to implement high-quality solutions with zero errors in fintech.     Some may think that the technical aspects aren’t visible to users, so why spend money?   The software development aspects may […]
content:
Just like any other business, software development is critical to Fintech. Even a minor error can lead to long-term consequences. So, it is necessary to implement high-quality solutions with zero errors in fintech.    

Some may think that the technical aspects aren’t visible to users, so why spend money?  

The software development aspects may not directly but indirectly affect your users. For instance, it will start by affecting their ease of use, resilience, performance, and in the end, their retention. 

Software Architecture 

For a project launch to be successful, you must have a balanced architecture. Therefore, while starting MVP development, you need to do two things. The first thing you need to do is prepare in advance for your future project growth. Secondly, define the software architecture depending on the long-term goals of your project. 

Neither under-engineering nor overengineering is going to offer you results. Under-engineering can limit the scalability and functionality of your software while overengineering can lead to budget overruns. These factors are unfavorable for a startup to survive.  

So, ask your development team not to design infrastructure that might be useful in the distant future. It will only add up to your maintenance and development costs.  

Security 

Fintech apps are always at risk of breach. Therefore, you must not take security aspects lightly. Similarly, you must also pay attention to 24/7 monitoring, extra verification steps, extended logging, and automated blocking of suspicious activities. 

A good fintech app should strictly abide by data encryption and security requirements, thereby offering users a decent UI/UX.  

Regulation Compliance 

Every startup must understand that fintech solutions are vulnerable to fraud, sanctions evasion, and money laundering. So, your compliance strategy must be at the top of the list of fintech software requirements.  

All startups must take pen tests, do regular audits, look for security issues, and undertake certifications. Aside from that, they must also abide by announced regulations constantly. 

UI/UX 

Your fintech projects must offer a straightforward solution to a user’s problem. These problems can either be related to improving the cost, speed, or process efficiency.  

Let’s take the example of PayPal. It used the email of recipients to introduce quick and easy payments. Similarly, Stripe added a few lines of code to solve the payment integration problem.  

Solving users’ problems faster will bring value to your business. Make sure that user flow doesn’t have any uncertainty or ambiguity. 

External Components 

A lot of ready-made external components are already available in the market, e.g., payment gateways, biometrics security, real-time analytics charts, etc. These come with increased quality and can help you to launch faster.  

Thus, reinvention isn’t needed but you must know where to place and adjust every wheel. Since frameworks and libraries cover varied use cases, you must adapt them for specific project requirements. 

In this way, you can ensure that a third-party component works at its full capacity. 

Conclusion 

Whether your users are new or not, everyone expects the same satisfaction. As a startup, it should be your goal to offer them the same. Make sure to deliver a steady, straightforward flow while complying with industry standards.

content:
Digital transformation initiatives have made far-reaching changes in the work processes today. This ultimately led to increasing demand for software.  

However, the number of software developers for developing solutions ran short as compared to the digital initiatives. To cope with it, citizen development came into place.

Also Read: From Idea to App: 5 Android Development Fundamentals for Newbies

Explore the impact of investing in citizen development for organizations.

The citizen development program proved itself to be a critical asset to businesses. However, many are still not aware of its benefits. In this blog, we give you the top 5 reasons why companies must invest in citizen development. 

1. Streamlines Business Processes 

Organizations always look for a way to easily handle the business process. The simpler the processes are, the easier it is for the organization to manage them. Citizen development helps to simplify business processes, thereby bringing workplace fluidity and boosting strong communication within departments. 

2. Speeds Up Product Development and Delivery

Since market conditions change consistently, organizations must possess a roadmap to rapidly release their products or services into the market. Employing a citizen development model can aid in this case by speeding up the product development process and ensuring quicker service delivery. 

3. Enhances IT and Business Productivity

Citizen developers can make use of the right low-code/no-code platform for aligning IT and business processes. They can create apps without depending on the IT department – greatly reducing backlogs, optimizing costs, and increasing overall business productivity. 

4. Minimizes the Load on IT

Upskilling the non-technical workforce is a great way to reduce the load on the IT team. Businesses can use this strategy to bring more citizen developers into action and they can help in building critical apps faster and boost process efficiency. 

5. Improves Transparency

With citizen development, more and more employees will be developing their apps. This means that there will be fewer cases of shadow IT or redundancies in the app development process. It will further lead to easy sharing of tools and resources, thereby enhancing organizational transparency.

Conclusion: Investing in Non-tech Teams 

Empowering citizen developers with low-code/no-code platforms can safely refine business processes. That’s why organizations must start investing in citizen development if they haven’t done it yet. Organizations that embrace a good citizen development program are more likely to have happier employees and efficient business operations.

title: 5 Steps to Take Before Starting Your First App Project
excerpt: Starting your first app project is an exciting journey, but it can also be overwhelming if you don’t complete the proper planning.
content:
Starting your first app project is an exciting journey, but it can also be overwhelming if you don’t complete the proper planning. The success of your app will be determined not just by its design and functionality, but also by the foundation you establish before entering development. Here are five important actions you should take before launching your first app project:

Define Your App’s Purpose and Goals

Before developing a single line of code, you must precisely describe the objective of your project. What problem does it solve? Who is your target audience? What are the primary features and functionalities that will differentiate your app from competitors? Take the time to develop a clear roadmap for what your app hopes to accomplish.

A thorough grasp of your app’s objective will influence all decisions made during the project.

Conduct Marketing Research

Understanding the industry and competition is critical to ensure your app’s success. Look for apps that are like yours and evaluate their merits and weaknesses. This can provide useful insights into what works and does not, allowing you to uncover possible market gaps.

Additionally, getting feedback from your target audience (by surveys, interviews, and so on) will help you better understand their demands.

Sketch Up Your App’s Wireframe and Design

Begin conceptualizing the UX once you’ve determined the goal and target audience for your app. A wireframe is a blueprint that describes the fundamental layout and functionality of your app, allowing you to see how users will interact with it. You may develop interactive prototypes without writing code using tools such as Sketch, Figma, and Adobe XD.

Creating a strong wireframe will save you time in development while ensuring that your app’s design is user-friendly.

Select the Right Technology Stack

Choosing the correct technological stack (the combination of tools, programming languages, and frameworks) is an important decision that will affect your app’s performance and scalability. For your initial app, you should balance utility and simplicity. Decide if your app will be native (iOS/Android) or cross-platform (React Native, Flutter), and ensure you have the necessary backend infrastructure.

Choosing the correct technology early on ensures that your app has a strong base and can scale as needed.

Plan Your Budget and Timeline

Creating an app may be expensive, particularly for your first project. It is critical to design a realistic budget and timeframe that accounts for the development process and any unexpected charges. Make sure to budget for hiring developers (if necessary), design, marketing, app store fees, and continuous maintenance.

A well-planned budget and timeline can help you remain on track, prevent unforeseen expenses, and launch your app on time.

Conclusion

By following these five critical steps—defining your app’s goal, conducting extensive research, developing a good UX, picking the correct technology stack, and budgeting your budget and timeline—you can ensure success in the app development process. These preliminary procedures not only keep you organized but also ensure that you’re creating an app that fits your users’ demands and stands out in the competitive app market.

title: 5 Things to Consider When Selecting A New Technology Vendor
excerpt: Choosing a new technology vendor or partner in today’s digital workplace is a huge decision for any firm. While most leadership teams are aware of the “big picture” characteristics to look for, some might not be aware of them. That’s why it is critical to go into the details to ensure that the possible vendor […]
content:
Choosing a new technology vendor or partner in today’s digital workplace is a huge decision for any firm. While most leadership teams are aware of the “big picture” characteristics to look for, some might not be aware of them.

That’s why it is critical to go into the details to ensure that the possible vendor or partner is indeed the greatest fit for your specific needs. In an era where budget is scarce and expert assistance is difficult to come by, the right technology vendor or partner can have a significant impact on the company.

Here are some crucial elements that a company should carefully consider when assessing a possible new technology vendor or partner.

Security Stance

Examine the new partner’s security posture, certifications, and attestations, as each touchpoint of the partnership represents a possible new exposure for your firm. Your primary responsibility to the business is to secure data and infrastructure. If partner interactions are not vetted beforehand, they may increase risk.

Accessibility Commitment

Today, technology is rapidly developing. Therefore, it is crucial to build relationships with technology companies that share strong ideals around inclusivity. Individuals with disabilities should not be denied the opportunity to explore and use cutting-edge technology.

Onboarding Time

The partner’s onboarding pace is one of the most important variables to consider. This is the time it would take them to comprehend your business processes and alter or incorporate their technology to fit the needs of your company.

Proven Compatibility and Established Integrations

When it comes to new technology, proven compatibility and established integrations with current systems are a “meta consideration”. It encompasses many other important factors such as security, supportability, scalability, stability, and robustness. Spending significant time evaluating host-system compliance will help improve scope clarity and minimize suffering.

Acceleration

Learn more about the velocity of your partner or provider. The concept of a “complete” product doesn’t exist. Even if you believe at first that your vendor’s solution is all you would ever require, you will quickly discover you require more. Once you locate the missing component, it is imperative that you move at the same pace as your supplier so that nothing important for your organization is delayed for months.

Final Words

Finding the ideal technology partner is akin to finding a true soul mate who shares your beliefs and understanding of your demands. It’s a choice that shouldn’t be made lightly because at some point, you’ll need professional advice in future and your resources will always be limited. However, an appropriate partner can help you succeed and make all the difference in your journey toward a digital workplace.

title: 5 UI UX Improvements That Instantly Boost Customer Satisfaction
excerpt: A great product is not just about features. It’s about how easy, clear, and pleasant it feels to use. When people land on your website or open your app, they decide quickly whether they trust it, understand it, and want to stay. Small UI UX improvement efforts can dramatically improve satisfaction. Here are five improvements […]
content:
A great product is not just about features. It’s about how easy, clear, and pleasant it feels to use. When people land on your website or open your app, they decide quickly whether they trust it, understand it, and want to stay.

Small UI UX improvement efforts can dramatically improve satisfaction. Here are five improvements that make an immediate difference.

1. Simplify Navigation

If users must think too hard about where to click, they get frustrated fast. Clean navigation reduces confusion and helps people reach their goals without effort.

Focus on fewer menu items, clear labels, and logical grouping. Use familiar patterns instead of trying to reinvent the wheel with layouts. A visible search bar also helps users who prefer direct navigation.

When navigation feels obvious, satisfaction rises because users feel in control.

2. Improve Page Speed

Speed directly affects how people feel about your product. Even a one-second delay can increase bounce rates and hurt trust.

Optimize images, reduce heavy scripts, and use lazy loading where possible. Performance is one of the most impactful areas for UI UX improvement because users notice speed instantly.
Fast products feel reliable. Slow ones feel broken.

3. Reduce Form Friction

Forms are where many users drop off. Long fields, unclear errors, and repetitive inputs create frustration.

Simplify forms by:

• Asking only what you truly need
• Using autofill and smart defaults
• Showing inline validation
• Breaking long forms into steps

Clear error messages matter too. Instead of “Invalid input,” tell users exactly what needs fixing.
Smooth forms create a sense of progress, not effort. This is a simple but powerful UI UX improvement that directly impacts conversions.

4. Create Clear Visual Hierarchy

Users scan before they read. Visual hierarchy guides their attention and helps them understand what matters first.

Use:

• Larger headings for key information
• Contrast for primary actions
• Consistent spacing
• Clear CTA buttons

When hierarchy is strong, users feel less cognitive load. They don’t have to figure things out. The interface quietly leads them.

5. Provide Instant Feedback

People need reassurance that something happened after they click. Without feedback, interfaces feel confusing.

Add micro-interactions like:

• Loading indicators
• Success states
• Hover feedback
• Progress bars
• Confirmation messages

These small signals build trust. Users feel guided rather than abandoned. Adding feedback loops is a foundational UI UX improvement that makes products feel responsive and alive.

Final Thoughts

Customer satisfaction rarely comes from big redesigns. It usually comes from removing friction.
Clear navigation, faster performance, simpler forms, strong hierarchy, and meaningful feedback all reduce effort. Consistent UI UX improvement helps users stay longer, complete tasks faster, and trust your product more.

The best UI/UX often feels invisible. It simply works.

title: 6 Android Development Trends in 2025 That You Can’t Afford to Ignore

content:
2025 isn’t just another year for Android; it’s a turning point. As consumer expectations rise and AI-driven experiences become the norm, Android developers face both exciting opportunities and critical decisions. Whether you’re building your first app or leading an enterprise mobile team, staying ahead of these 6 Android development trends could define your success this year.

Here are six Android development trends in 2025 you can’t afford to overlook.

1. AI-First Android Apps: From Add-On to Core Feature

In 2025, AI isn’t just a tool, it’s the engine behind smarter, faster, and more intuitive apps. Among the 6 Android development trends shaping the future, from on-device ML Kit enhancements to Gemini AI integration with Android Studio, developers are embedding AI at the core of the user experience.

Example: Google’s Gemini in Android Studio now helps generate boilerplate code, optimise layouts, and suggest logic improvements in real-time.

Expect to see more predictive features, think AI-generated captions, personalised recommendations, and voice-first navigation.

2. Foldables and Large Screen Optimisation Go Mainstream

With foldables like the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold6 and Pixel Fold 2 becoming more affordable, one of the 6 Android development trends is that apps now must scale across screens. Google’s Jetpack Window Manager and responsive UI guidelines are essential to designing experiences that feel native on any display.

Start here: Large screen development on Android
This isn’t niche anymore, it’s where premium users are headed.

3. Kotlin Multiplatform Is Coming of Age

2025 might be the year Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) becomes the standard for shared codebases across Android, iOS, and backend. JetBrains recently released KMP 2.0, making cross-platform development more stable and production-ready.

Explore: Kotlin Multiplatform by JetBrains
It’s a game-changer for teams looking to cut dev time without compromising native feel.

4. Privacy-First Design with Android 15 & 16

As Android 15 rolls out and Android 16 previews kick in, privacy is now a design principle, not an afterthought. New runtime permission flows, AI-anonymised data collection, and secure credential storage via Passkeys are rewriting how apps handle data.

Dive into changes: Android 15 Developer preview
Users are more aware than ever, privacy is not just compliance, it’s trust.

5. Jetpack Compose Dominates UI Development

Jetpack Compose has officially overtaken XML layouts in new Android projects, offering cleaner code, faster UI iteration, and seamless Material You integration. In 2025, it’s not just recommended—it’s expected as one of the 6 Android development trends shaping the future.

Hands-on tutorial: Jetpack Compose pathway
Expect libraries, plugins, and team hiring practices to reflect this shift.

6. App Store Alternatives Gain Ground

With increasing scrutiny over app store fees, more developers are eyeing third-party Android app stores and progressive web apps (PWAs). Initiatives like the Open App Markets Act in the U.S. and the EU’s Digital Markets Act are empowering more freedom.

Read more: Epic vs Google and the Future of App Stores
This trend could reshape distribution models, especially for indie and subscription-based apps.

Final Thought

2025 is shaping up to be a transformative year for Android development, not because of one shiny tool, but because of how all these trends combine to demand a smarter, more responsible approach to mobile creation. Whether you’re solo or leading a team, the choices you make today will define your Android app’s success tomorrow.

title: 6 Quick Wins to Turn Your App into a UX Superstar
excerpt: Want to transform your app from “meh” to “wow”? You don’t need a complete redesign; just a few smart tweaks can make a world of difference. Here are 6 quick wins to elevate your app’s user experience and keep your users coming back for more. 1. Simplify Navigation Users should never feel lost in your […]
content:
Want to transform your app from “meh” to “wow”? You don’t need a complete redesign; just a few smart tweaks can make a world of difference. Here are 6 quick wins to elevate your app’s user experience and keep your users coming back for more.

1. Simplify Navigation

Users should never feel lost in your app. Streamline your menus and ensure that key features are easy to find. A cluttered interface can overwhelm users and drive them away. By simplifying navigation, you make the user journey smoother and more intuitive.

2. Optimise for Speed

Nobody likes waiting. If your app takes too long to load or respond, users will quickly lose patience. Here are 6 quick wins to boost your app’s performance: optimise images, reduce unnecessary animations, minimise heavy scripts, leverage caching, test on various devices, and streamline network requests. A swift app keeps users engaged and satisfied.

3. Prioritise Mobile Responsiveness

With billions of smartphone users worldwide, ensuring your app is mobile-friendly is crucial. Responsive design adapts your app’s layout to different screen sizes, providing a seamless experience across devices. This adaptability enhances user satisfaction and accessibility.

4. Use White Space Effectively

Less can be more. Here are 6 quick wins to improve your app’s design: incorporating ample white space can make content more readable and the interface less overwhelming. It helps users focus on important elements and creates a clean, organised look. Don’t be afraid of empty spaces, they can enhance usability.

5. Gather User Feedback

Your users are your best critics. Regularly collect feedback through in-app surveys or usability tests to understand pain points and areas for improvement. Acting on this feedback shows users that you value their input and are committed to enhancing their experience.

6. Implement Clear Call-to-Actions (CTAs)

Guide your users with clear and compelling CTAs. Here are 6 quick wins to make them more effective: make buttons easy to find and understand, use concise text like “Sign Up,” “Learn More,” or “Get Started,” and apply contrasting colors to draw attention and encourage action.

By focusing on these six areas, you can significantly enhance your app’s user experience without overhauling the entire design. Remember, small improvements can lead to big results in user satisfaction and retention.

title: 7 AI Tools Transforming Android and Web App Development
excerpt: AI is quietly reshaping how apps are built. Tasks that once took hours of coding, debugging, and testing can now be completed in minutes with AI-powered tools. For developers building Android and web applications, these tools don’t replace creativity or engineering skills, but they dramatically speed up development and reduce repetitive work. From mobile solutions […]
content:
AI is quietly reshaping how apps are built. Tasks that once took hours of coding, debugging, and testing can now be completed in minutes with AI-powered tools. For developers building Android and web applications, these tools don’t replace creativity or engineering skills, but they dramatically speed up development and reduce repetitive work.

From mobile solutions to web app development, AI is helping teams build smarter applications faster than ever before.

Here are seven AI tools that are making a real impact on modern app development.

1. GitHub Copilot

One of the most widely used AI coding assistants today is GitHub Copilot. It acts like a virtual pair programmer inside your IDE, suggesting entire lines or blocks of code as you type.

Copilot uses machine learning trained on large code datasets to generate suggestions in real time. Developers can ask it to write functions, generate documentation, or even explain existing code. This reduces time spent on boilerplate tasks and lets developers focus more on architecture and problem-solving in both mobile projects and web app development.

2. Firebase ML Kit

Adding machine learning features to mobile apps used to require deep expertise in AI. Firebase ML Kit changed that by providing ready-to-use APIs for tasks like text recognition, barcode scanning, face detection, and language translation.

Developers can integrate these capabilities into Android apps with only a few lines of code. The SDK also supports custom models, allowing teams to deploy their own machine learning solutions without building the infrastructure from scratch. These capabilities can also support intelligent features within broader web app development ecosystems connected to mobile services.

3. TensorFlow Lite

When it comes to running machine learning models directly on mobile devices, TensorFlow Lite is one of the most popular frameworks. It enables developers to deploy optimized ML models on Android apps, allowing features like image recognition or predictive recommendations to run offline.

This approach improves privacy and reduces latency since data processing happens directly on the user’s device rather than in the cloud.

4. Firebase AI Logic (Vertex AI Integration)

Google has expanded Firebase with AI capabilities that make it easier to integrate generative AI features into mobile and web apps. With Firebase AI Logic, developers can connect applications to large language models through tools like Genkit and Vertex AI.

This allows apps to include features such as AI chatbots, smart content generation, and personalized recommendations without complex backend setup. These capabilities are becoming especially valuable for modern web app development, where interactive AI-driven features are increasingly expected.

5. OpenAI Codex

AI-powered coding assistants have evolved rapidly, and OpenAI Codex represents a major step forward. It can interpret natural language prompts and generate working code for web applications, APIs, and automation scripts.

Instead of manually writing every line of code, developers can describe what they want in plain English and let the AI generate a starting point. This approach is particularly useful during prototyping and early-stage web app development, when teams need to move quickly.

6. Google Antigravity

Google’s experimental AI development environment, Antigravity, focuses on using autonomous agents to assist with coding tasks. Built as an AI-powered IDE, it allows developers to delegate complex development work to AI agents that can analyze codebases and generate solutions.
Although still in preview, tools like this show how AI-driven development environments may evolve in the coming years.

7. Eclipse Theia with AI Extensions

Eclipse Theia is an open-source platform for building cloud-based development environments. Its architecture allows AI tools to be integrated directly into the IDE, enabling features such as intelligent code completion, automated debugging, and AI-driven refactoring.

Because Theia is highly customizable, many teams use it to create AI-enhanced developer platforms tailored to their workflow for both enterprise systems and web app development.

Final Thoughts

AI isn’t replacing developers, but it is changing how software gets built. From intelligent code generation to built-in machine learning features, these tools are helping developers move faster and experiment more freely.

For Android and web app development, the biggest shift is clear. Developers are no longer just writing code. They’re collaborating with AI systems that help design, build, and optimize applications along the way.

As these tools continue to evolve, the future of app development will likely be less about writing every line manually and more about guiding intelligent systems to create better software.

title: 7 Steps to Help Prevent & Limit the Impact of Ransomware
excerpt: Ransomware attacks can happen on any organization, big or small. In the last few years, ransomware threats have increased significantly and can cause major damage to organizations.
content:
Ransomware attacks can happen on any organization, big or small. In the last few years, ransomware threats have increased significantly and can cause major damage to organizations. However, though they are common, it is not difficult to prevent them.   

What is ransomware?

Ransomware is a type of malware that is deployed to an organization’s computers through phishing attacks. The attackers send emails with malicious links or attachments that download the ransomware software when clicked on. This lets the attackers gain access to the organization’s systems. The attackers may ask for a ransom by threatening to erase files or leak critical information about the organization. 

How to prevent and limit the impact of ransomware?

Preventing ransomware requires the entire organization to work together. Here are the seven ways you can prevent ransomware and limit its impact. 

1. Developing policies and plans

Having a plan for ransomware attacks helps you stay prepared if there’s an actual attack. The plan must be elaborate and have defined communication and roles in case of an attack. You should also have a list of important people like clients and vendors to be notified immediately when there’s an attack. Also, create policies for suspicious emails so that employees can notify the IT team. 

2. Maintaining thoughtful backups

Having a backup for critical data can prove to be incredibly helpful in case of a ransomware attack. However, the backup files must be properly protected and stored offline so that the attackers don’t get access to the backup. Keep the backup updated and test it regularly to ensure efficacy. 

3. Keeping systems updated

Ensure that all the operating systems, software, and apps are always updated. Maintaining updated systems closes the security gaps that attackers can target to gain access. The best way to stay updated is to turn on auto-updates on all systems. 

4. Reviewing port settings

Some ransomware uses ports like Remote Desktop Protocol ports and Server Message Block ports to gain access. Review settings for these ports for on-premises and cloud environments and consider if you need to leave these ports open or give limited access to trusted hosts. 

5. Hardening the endpoints

Secure configuration settings can close security gaps from default configurations and limit the threat surface of the organization. It is important to have the systems configured by keeping security in mind. 

6. Implementing an IDS

An IDS or Intrusion Detection System compares network traffic logs to signatures that detect known malicious activities. If any potential malicious activity is detected, an IDS will immediately notify the organization. 

7. Training the employees

The best way to stay protected from a ransomware attack is to generate awareness about it in your organization. Conducting security awareness training for all employees in an organization helps prevent the risk of ransomware attacks through phishing. Employees should be told not to click on any suspicious links or attachments in their mail and notify the IT department if they receive any such emails.

title: 8 Must Know API Security Threats
excerpt: APIs are a great source of sensitive data and network resources for users, applications, and IoT devices. Hence, their security is of utmost importance.
content:
APIs are a great source of sensitive data and network resources for users, applications, and IoT devices. Hence, their security is of utmost importance.

A lack of a strong security layer will leave your devices and data vulnerable to a wide range of attacks.

API security aims to ensure that API requests are validated, authorized, authenticated, cleaned, and able to be executed even during periods of high service demand.

The characteristics of API security are distinct from ordinary web servers, which only need to protect a few basic ports and requests because a modern application or service has several API endpoints that employ diverse protocols and request formats.

When developing an API or updating one, the following security vulnerabilities should be taken into consideration.

1. Broken object-level authorization

BOLA happens when a request can access or change information that the requestor shouldn’t have access to. An example of this would be if a requester tampered with an identifier to get access to another user’s account.

2. Broken function-level authorization.

This occurs when the principle of least privilege (POLP) is not followed, which frequently happens as a result of too intricate access control regulations. As a result, an attacker can access endpoints meant for privileged accounts or execute sensitive commands.

3. Broken user authentication

Similar to BOLA, an attacker can temporarily or permanently assume the identity of another user if the authentication procedure is breached.

4. An abundance of data exposure

An API response to a request frequently yields more information than is required or pertinent. Sensitive information may be exposed even though the data may not be seen by the user, but it is still easily analyzed.

5. Poor asset management

In the race to offer new or updated APIs, comprehensive documentation is frequently overlooked during the typically fast-paced development and deployment of APIs. This results in exposed and ghost endpoints and a lack of knowledge about the functionality and implementation requirements of older APIs.

6. Insufficient resources and rate limiting

If there are no limitations on the quantity or size of requests, API endpoints are often accessible over the internet and are vulnerable to brute-force and denial-of-service attacks.

7. Errors in injection

An attacker may use a command or SQL injection attack to obtain request data or run malicious commands without authorization if it is not properly parsed and validated.

8. Mass assignment

Software development frameworks frequently demonstrated the ability to perform mass assignment, which eliminates the need for repetitive lines of form-mapping code, by inserting all the data received from an online form into a database or object with just one line of code. If this is carried out without defining what kind of data is allowed, numerous attack avenues become available.

title: 8 Ways Quantum Computing Could Change the World
excerpt: Imagine trying to solve a Rubik’s cube… but blindfolded, underwater, and with one hand tied behind your back. That’s kind of how today’s computers tackle ultra-complex problems. Now imagine a machine that doesn’t just solve the cube—it solves every possible configuration at once and gives you the best answer instantly. Welcome to the mind-bending realm […]
content:
Imagine trying to solve a Rubik’s cube… but blindfolded, underwater, and with one hand tied behind your back. That’s kind of how today’s computers tackle ultra-complex problems. Now imagine a machine that doesn’t just solve the cube—it solves every possible configuration at once and gives you the best answer instantly.

Welcome to the mind-bending realm of quantum computing—a technology so powerful, it’s not just a faster computer; it’s a whole new kind of thinking.

Here are 8 ways quantum computing could completely transform our world—faster than you can say “qubit.”

1. Revolutionizing Drug Discovery

Traditional drug discovery can take over a decade and billions of dollars. Quantum computing could slash that time by simulating molecular interactions with unprecedented accuracy.

IBM is already partnering with Moderna to use quantum tools for mRNA research. It’s not sci-fi—it’s already happening.

2. Breaking (and Rebuilding) Encryption

Today’s online security is based on math problems that take classical computers years to crack. Quantum computers could solve them in minutes.

That sounds terrifying—because it is. But it also means we’re moving toward post-quantum cryptography, where new security systems are being developed before the old one’s break.

Read how the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) is prepping our digital defenses for the quantum age.

3. Supercharging AI

AI is powerful, but it’s still bottlenecked by the hardware it runs on. Quantum computing could exponentially accelerate training for machine learning models, especially when it comes to recognizing patterns in vast, unstructured data.

Imagine smarter chatbots, more accurate medical diagnoses, or even AI-powered scientific discoveries.

Google’s Quantum AI team is already experimenting with quantum-enhanced machine learning.

4. Cracking the Climate Code

Modelling climate systems is one of the hardest problems in science—it requires understanding complex, chaotic systems across decades and continents.

Quantum computing could simulate those systems more accurately, helping us predict climate events and optimize solutions like carbon capture or geoengineering.

Microsoft’s Azure Quantum team is researching quantum impact on climate science.

5. Reinventing Financial Modelling

Quantum algorithms could simulate market behaviour, optimize investment portfolios, and manage risk in a way classical computers never could.

Think of it as moving from grainy black-and-white to full HD colour when understanding the chaos of global markets.

Banks like HSBC and JPMorgan are already testing quantum capabilities for portfolio optimization.

6. Transforming Logistics and Supply Chains

Quantum computers can solve optimization problems—like finding the fastest delivery route among thousands of options—faster than you can type “where’s my package?”

This has massive implications for global shipping, warehouse management, and even traffic control in smart cities.

7. Powering the Energy Revolution

Whether it’s building better batteries or optimizing energy grids, quantum computing could accelerate the transition to clean energy.

Picture electric vehicles with batteries that last 10x longer or grid systems that waste less power.

Volkswagen and BMW are partnering with quantum computing companies to design better EV batteries.

8. Unlocking the Universe’s Mysteries

Quantum physics gave us the universe’s weirdest puzzles—and now, quantum computing might help solve them.

From simulating black holes to understanding dark matter, these machines could help physicists run the kinds of experiments that are impossible in real life.

CERN is exploring quantum tech to study fundamental particles and forces.

Also read: A Look into Tomorrow with Quantum Computing

title: A Look into Tomorrow with Quantum Computing
excerpt:
Quantum computing stands at the forefront of technological innovation, promising to revolutionize the way we process information and solve complex problems.

Quantum supremacy, when a quantum computer beats a traditional computer or supercomputer in a specific computer science task, is on the horizon. It will pave the way for a new era of computational power and discovery.
content:
Quantum computing stands at the forefront of technological innovation, promising to revolutionize the way we process information and solve complex problems.

Unlike classical computers, which rely on bits to represent data in binary form, quantum computers leverage quantum bits or qubits, which can exist in multiple states simultaneously.

This unique property enables quantum computers to perform calculations at an exponentially faster rate, unlocking new possibilities in fields ranging from cryptography to drug discovery.

Current Stage of Quantum Computing

While quantum computing is still in its infancy, significant progress has been made in recent years. Major players such as IBM, Google, and Microsoft have developed prototype quantum computers with increasingly powerful capabilities.

These machines, though still experimental, have demonstrated the potential to outperform classical supercomputers on certain tasks, heralding a new era of computing power.

Significance and Impact

The significance of quantum computing lies in its ability to tackle complex problems that are beyond the reach of classical computers.

Its impact extends far beyond computational speed, offering solutions to some of the most pressing challenges facing humanity.

Future Projections

Looking ahead, the future of quantum computing is filled with possibilities. As researchers continue to refine qubit technologies and overcome the challenges of quantum error correction, we can expect quantum computers to become increasingly powerful and reliable.

Breakthroughs in quantum algorithms and software will further enhance their capabilities, enabling applications in areas such as cryptography, machine learning, and optimization.

From quantum internet and secure communication protocols to quantum machine learning and AI, the possibilities are limitless.

Quantum supremacy, when a quantum computer beats a traditional computer or supercomputer in a specific computer science task, is on the horizon. It will pave the way for a new era of computational power and discovery.

title: Amp Up Automation: A Guide to PLCs
excerpt: Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) comes through as an integral part of the growth journey of manufacturers as it can make the entire production process control more integrated and efficient.
content:
Modern-day manufacturers are shifting towards industrial IoT with a keener adoption of smart devices, connected machinery, and other digital tools. As interconnectivity and automation lie at the heart of advancement, creating communication channels with machines and technology to automate tasks and minimize human involvement has become a non-negotiable factor.

Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) comes through as an integral part of the growth journey of manufacturers as it can make the entire production process control more integrated and efficient.

Programmable logic controllers (PLCs) are workhorses in the world of automation. They are industrial computers designed to control complex systems in various applications, particularly within manufacturing and railway industries. PLCs excel at automating repetitive tasks, improving efficiency, and reducing errors.

Here’s how Programmable Logic Controllers can benefit your operations.

Enhanced Efficiency

PLCs automate tasks with precision, significantly reducing production time and increasing overall output.

Improved Accuracy

PLCs follow programmed instructions consistently, minimizing human error and ensuring consistent product quality.

Reduced Costs

Automation with PLCs can lead to lower labor costs and less material waste, boosting your bottom line.

Increased Flexibility

PLCs are programmable, allowing you to adapt your automation processes to meet changing production needs.

Reliable Performance

PLCs are built for industrial environments, withstanding harsh conditions and ensuring smooth operations.

Easier Maintenance

PLCs offer modular designs, simplifying troubleshooting and maintenance procedures.

Considering Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) for your Business?

PLCs offer a powerful and versatile solution for automating tasks across various industries. If you’re looking to optimize your operations, improve efficiency, and achieve greater control, PLCs might be the right fit for you. Here are some factors to consider.

  • Complexity of Tasks: PLCs excel at automating repetitive, rule-based tasks
  • Production Needs: Evaluate your current production volume and the desired level of automation
  • Budget: While PLCs offer long-term benefits, upfront costs should be factored into your decision

By carefully assessing your needs and conducting a cost-benefit analysis, you can determine if Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) are the key to unlocking greater automation and efficiency in your business.

title: Are PLCs Becoming Obsolete? Why 2025 Isn’t the End—It’s a New Beginning
excerpt: Walk into any factory or processing plant today, and you’re likely to find a Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) silently running the show. These industrial workhorses have been around for over 50 years—reliable, robust, and custom-built for automation tasks. But as we step into 2025, a question looms large: Are PLCs becoming obsolete? The short answer: […]
content:
Walk into any factory or processing plant today, and you’re likely to find a Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) silently running the show. These industrial workhorses have been around for over 50 years—reliable, robust, and custom-built for automation tasks. But as we step into 2025, a question looms large: Are PLCs becoming obsolete?

The short answer: No, but they are evolving.

The Legacy and the Limitations

Let’s not sugarcoat it—PLCs have limitations. They were designed in an era when closed-loop systems, real-time control, and ruggedised hardware were the priority. But with modern industrial operations increasingly relying on cloud integration, AI processing, and real-time analytics, we’re now seeing PLCs becoming obsolete for many advanced use cases.

According to a report by ARC, PLCs are being challenged by more flexible, data-rich systems like Programmable Automation Controllers (PACs) and Industrial PC (IPCs). These alternatives offer more memory, higher processing power, and seamless integration with modern software ecosystems.

But does that mean PLCs are done for?

2025: Not the End, But a Turning Point

Rather than viewing 2025 as the year of PLCs becoming obsolete, it’s more accurate to see it as the inflexion point—a time when PLCs are being reimagined to fit into Industry 4.0 and even Industry 5.0 landscapes.

Here’s why PLCs are far from obsolete:

1. PLCs Are Getting Smarter
Leading manufacturers like Siemens, Rockwell Automation, and Schneider Electric are rolling out PLCs that now support edge computing, remote diagnostics, and even AI-based fault detection. For instance, Siemens’ SIMATIC S7 series now offers cloud connectivity and predictive analytics capabilities.

2. Hybrid Architectures Are the Future
We’re moving toward hybrid automation architectures, where traditional PLCs work alongside cloud-based systems. Think of it as the brain (cloud/AI) and the reflexes (PLCs) working in sync. This cyber-physical fusion allows industries to maintain the real-time responsiveness of PLCs while also gaining the big-picture insights from cloud analytics—challenging the notion of PLCs becoming obsolete by instead evolving their role within smarter, connected systems.

3. Cybersecurity and Reliability Still Favour PLCs
Despite the hype around Industrial IoT and AI, many industrial environments still prioritise deterministic control and cybersecurity. PLCs—especially when isolated from broader networks—are inherently more secure and reliable than open, internet-connected systems.

According to ISA Global Cybersecurity Alliance, protecting critical infrastructure requires a layered, secure-by-design approach, which PLCs still help facilitate.

4. Workforce Familiarity Matters
There’s a massive installed base of technicians, engineers, and plant managers who are trained on PLC systems. However, with PLCs becoming obsolete in many areas, rather than undergoing an expensive, risky transition, many businesses are opting for incremental upgrades to smarter PLC platforms.

Final Thoughts

Are PLCs becoming obsolete? No.

Are they changing? Absolutely.

Think of it not as a funeral for old tech, but a renaissance for industrial automation.
And the best part? You don’t have to choose between old and new. The future belongs to companies that can integrate both worlds seamlessly balancing the reliability of PLCs with the agility of next-gen tech.

title: Benefits of AI-Driven PLCs: Boosting Productivity and Reducing Downtime
excerpt: Industrial automation is not an exception to the way AI has begun to make waves in a variety of industries in recent years. content:
Industrial automation is not an exception to the way AI has begun to make waves in a variety of industries in recent years. Programmable Logic Controller (PLCs) and AI integration are some of the most noteworthy developments in this field. By increasing overall efficiency, decreasing downtime, and increasing production, these AI-driven PLCs are revolutionizing manufacturing operations.
A closer look into how AI-powered PLCs might increase output and reduce downtime is provided below:

1. Predictive Upkeep

Predictive maintenance is made possible by machine learning algorithms found in AI-driven PLCs. Conventional maintenance models frequently use reactive methods or set schedules, fixing equipment only after it breaks. On the other hand, AI-powered PLCs keep an eye on equipment in real-time, identifying irregularities and possible problems before they arise. This makes it possible to act quickly, avoiding expensive malfunctions and production stops. Businesses may prevent unplanned downtime and maintain smooth operations by anticipating and proactively resolving maintenance needs.

2. Production Process Optimization

Through the analysis of data from several sensors, machines, and environmental elements, AI may optimize industrial processes. AI-driven PLCs can optimize operations through real-time data analysis. Based on ongoing feedback, these systems can instantly modify settings, change machine speeds, and make other modifications. This leads to increased productivity by maintaining production at optimal levels and improving output quality.

3. Improved Quality Assurance

A crucial component of manufacturing is quality control, which AI-driven PLCs help to improve. These systems may instantly identify flaws or variations from the intended product specs using AI algorithms. AI PLCs continuously monitor the production process and instantly identify problems, allowing for quick adjustments to prevent the manufacture of defective goods. This contrasts with previous approaches that could rely on periodic inspections. Higher quality products and less waste result from this, which boosts productivity and lowers costs.

4. Making Decisions Based on Data

PLCs with AI capabilities gather and examine enormous data from the manufacturing floor. This information offers important insights into operational constraints, system performance, and possible areas for development. Operators and managers may make well-informed, data-driven decisions due to these intelligent technologies’ rapid processing of complicated datasets. AI-driven PLCs offer the resources required to improve operational decision-making, whether it is modifying a machine’s performance to reduce energy consumption or modifying a process to increase throughput.

Conclusion

PLCs powered by AI are a revolutionary development in the field of industrial automation. Businesses can gain a multitude of advantages by combining AI with PLCs, including improved quality control, energy efficiency, predictive maintenance, and better manufacturing processes. AI-powered PLCs will be more and more important as industries continue to adopt automation to preserve production, cut down on downtime, and remain competitive in the global market. Purchasing this technology now can pay off in the long run by assisting companies to thrive in a world that is becoming more automated and digital.

title: Best UX & UX Research Tools for Designers in 2026
